item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-6de235a36dde90b9","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"At the December 27–28, 2023 Central Foreign Affairs Work Conference, Xi Jinping presented a formal foreign-policy program centered on maintaining sovereignty, security, and development interests; promoting peace, global governance, and a 'community with a shared future'; expanding partnerships and Belt and Road cooperation; and strengthening centralized Party leadership and interdepartmental implementation.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns Xi's formal 2023 foreign-policy program and implementation architecture, while some reported achievements cover the broader post-2012 period.","ruler_attribution":"The conference was chaired under Xi's authority; the source identifies him as General Secretary, President, and Central Military Commission Chairman and reports his speech and directives.","limitations":["The source is an official Chinese government account and primarily reports asserted achievements and intentions.","It does not independently verify implementation, outcomes, or the peacefulness of all policies."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6de235a36dde90b9","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The conference required continued centralized Party control over foreign affairs, coordinated action by regions and ministries, diplomatic team-building, and implementation of central decisions without deviation.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.5","8B.2","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly reported as a December 2023 institutional directive.","ruler_attribution":"The directive was issued through a conference presided over by Xi and explicitly reinforced centralized Party leadership of foreign affairs.","limitations":["The source does not provide independent evidence of compliance or administrative performance.","The fact describes centralized control, which is relevant to execution but also bears on institutional pluralism."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5bb786c31706ad97","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The supplied World Bank page identifies a China Economic Update titled 'Which Way Forward? Navigating China's Post-Pandemic Growth Path,' but the extracted material contains site navigation rather than the report's substantive findings.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The title concerns China's post-pandemic growth path, but the supplied extract does not establish a substantive 2023 fact.","ruler_attribution":"No Xi-specific decision, policy, or outcome is stated in the supplied substantive extract.","limitations":["Only navigation and title material was supplied; no economic findings can be reliably extracted."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0684cb88a27ce16f","start_unit":9,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"The Open Library record identifies Surveillance State: Inside China's Quest to Launch a New Era of Social Control as a 2023 St. Martin's Press edition by Josh Chin and Liza Lin, with subjects including social control, electronic surveillance, artificial intelligence, and internal security.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The record concerns a 2023 edition, but it does not provide substantive evidence about events or policies during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The bibliographic record does not attribute a specific 2023 action or outcome to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The supplied page is a bibliographic record with no description or accessible substantive preview.","The book's subject classifications are not sufficient evidence for a concrete ruler-period fact."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b23323f69a37a771","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In May 2023, residents in Nagu, Yunnan, clashed with large numbers of police over planned demolition or alteration of the Najiaying Mosque's dome; police issued a surrender and reporting notice, and dozens were arrested.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.7","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.7","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Direct event in May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report links the local enforcement action to the broader national policy of increased state control over organized religion and Xi's stated policy of religious 'Sinicisation,' but does not establish Xi's personal operational order for this incident.","limitations":["The report concerns local authorities and does not prove a direct personal order from Xi.","The BBC reports arrests and police-protester clashes but does not establish the legality or proportionality of each individual action.","The article notes that Beijing denies broader accusations of abuse in Xinjiang."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b23323f69a37a771","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Najiaying Mosque dispute followed a 2020 court judgment that ruled architectural additions illegal and ordered their removal; authorities' later attempt to enforce that order triggered the 2023 demonstrations.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The enforcement and protest occurred in 2023; the underlying judgment dates from 2020.","ruler_attribution":"No direct Xi order is identified; the incident is presented as part of national religious-control policy during Xi's tenure.","limitations":["The supplied extract does not provide the court judgment text or assess its independence.","It does not establish whether the 2023 enforcement complied with due-process requirements."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d414b6c48e30e632","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A 2022 Routledge book description characterizes Beijing's Taiwan policy as shifting from confrontation to cooperation and back to confrontation, and describes the post-2016 policy as 'selective engagement' with reunification as a core national objective.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","2B.7","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source analyzes the post-2016 period and is relevant to Xi's 2023 strategic context, but it does not report a specific 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The description concerns mainland policy under Xi Jinping's period of leadership, but does not attribute each policy choice personally to Xi.","limitations":["The supplied material is a publisher description, not the book's full evidence base.","It does not establish whether specific 2023 actions exceeded defensive necessity or how durable any diplomatic outcomes were."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6241b52c803468ee","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"UNICEF reported that in 2023, 79 countries had moderately strong or strong social-protection systems, 22 had systems able to respond effectively and rapidly to humanitarian crises, and 165 million children were reached by cash-transfer programmes, a more than 25 percent increase from 2022.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly reports global 2023 results, not China-specific results.","ruler_attribution":"The source does not identify Xi Jinping or China as the responsible ruler or country for these aggregate outcomes.","limitations":["The figures are global aggregates and cannot be assigned to Xi or China.","No China-specific policy, budget, or outcome is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bab56f702e448c99","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"A 2023 UNICEF/ODI paper reported that only 26.4 percent of children globally receive social-protection benefits and that displaced children and families often face policy exclusion or administrative barriers; it called for inclusive, shock-responsive, predictable long-term systems.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published in February 2023, but reports global conditions rather than a China-specific 2023 fact.","ruler_attribution":"The source does not identify Xi Jinping or China as responsible for the reported global access gap.","limitations":["The evidence is global and not ruler-specific.","The supplied extract gives no China-specific implementation or outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1304b67780a2107a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"SIPRI assessed that China was in the midst of significant nuclear-arsenal modernization and expansion in early 2023; its stockpile was expected to grow over the following decade and China might deploy at least as many ICBMs as Russia or the United States, while its total warhead stockpile was still expected to remain smaller than either.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.5","1B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"SIPRI's assessment is anchored at the start of 2023, with projections extending beyond the target year.","ruler_attribution":"The source assesses China's national program during Xi's tenure but does not identify a personal Xi directive or the precise decision-maker for the expansion.","limitations":["SIPRI reports open-source estimates and projections, not verified official Chinese inventories or orders.","The supplied extract does not establish China's nuclear doctrine, command safeguards, or intended use."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1304b67780a2107a","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"SIPRI reported that reliable information on the status and capabilities of nuclear-armed states varies considerably and that estimates can depend on fissile-material production and observations of missile forces.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The finding appears in the 2023 Yearbook and applies to the 2023 assessment environment.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns China's nuclear transparency among other nuclear-armed states, but does not attribute the information gap to a specific Xi decision.","limitations":["The extract does not provide a China-specific transparency score or identify which information is withheld.","It is an external assessment of information availability, not proof of a particular safety failure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-95623ba51a188124","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"A 2023 peer-reviewed Chinese economics study using 2010–2020 listed-firm data and the 2015 Budget Law as a quasi-natural experiment found that local-government debt governance reduced firms' credit mismatch, excessive indebtedness, leverage manipulation, shadow-banking and financialization-related risk correlations, and ultimately supported more stable operating performance.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published in 2023 but evaluates reforms and firm outcomes through 2020, so it provides lagged evidence rather than a direct 2023 result.","ruler_attribution":"The study evaluates a Chinese government debt-governance reform during Xi's broader period of national leadership, but does not establish Xi's personal authorship or implementation role.","limitations":["The study does not isolate Xi's personal decisions from broader state and legislative institutions.","Its sample covers non-financial listed firms and data through 2020, limiting direct inference about 2023.","The reported findings are observational causal estimates based on the study's design, not a complete national welfare assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-21e590ef8ba9da7b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On March 10, 2023, Xi was unanimously re-elected by the National People's Congress to a third five-year term as state president and also unanimously re-elected as chairman of the state Central Military Commission; NPR reported that he had previously orchestrated abolition of presidential term limits and that loyalists dominated key appointments.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.4","4B.5","4B.8","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Direct institutional events occurred in March 2023; the term-limit amendment occurred five years earlier and is relevant background.","ruler_attribution":"The reported constitutional change, re-election, consolidation, and appointments concern Xi's own continued rule and political authority.","limitations":["The NPC vote was unanimous, but the source characterizes the legislature as a 'rubber-stamp parliament'; the extract does not provide independent procedural records.","NPR reports analyst assessments that loyalist appointments may reduce policy expertise, but this is not a quantified administrative-performance finding.","The extract does not establish the full legal details of the constitutional amendment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-21e590ef8ba9da7b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"NPR reported that under Xi, the Party tightened its grip on society, limited freedom of expression, suppressed Hong Kong's democracy movement, pursued assimilation of minorities in Xinjiang, and conducted a broad military modernization; it also reported that China's growth had fallen from 7.8 percent in 2013 to 3 percent in 2022 amid COVID controls.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.5","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.7","4B.9","5B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The claims describe Xi's tenure through the 2023 re-election, while the growth comparison ends in 2022.","ruler_attribution":"NPR explicitly presents these as developments during Xi's time in power, though not every measure is attributed to a personal order.","limitations":["The extract summarizes analyst and UN-related assessments without providing underlying case records.","The growth comparison is not a 2023 outcome and is confounded by pandemic and other external conditions.","The source reports that the Chinese government denies accusations of abuse in Xinjiang."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4a541621a4912975","start_unit":10,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"According to a senior U.S. official quoted by Reuters after Xi's November 15, 2023 meeting with Joe Biden, Xi described Taiwan as the biggest and most dangerous issue in bilateral relations, stated a preference for peaceful reunification, and discussed conditions under which force could be used.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.5","1B.8","2B.1","2B.2","2B.3","2B.7","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns Xi's November 2023 bilateral meeting and reported statements.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the statements to Xi during his meeting with Biden, based on a senior U.S. official's account.","limitations":["The account is second-hand and does not provide a transcript or Xi's exact conditions for force.","The report says Xi was indicating China was not preparing for a massive invasion, but it does not establish the credibility or durability of that signal.","Taiwan's status and the parties' claims are politically contested."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2e51fa530cc99425","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The World Bank projected China's 2023 growth at 5.2 percent, with a projected slowdown to 4.5 percent in 2024; it identified continued real-estate weakness, high debt, population aging, slower productivity growth, and weak global demand as constraints and risks.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns the World Bank's December 2023 assessment and projection.","ruler_attribution":"The assessment concerns China's national economy during Xi's period of leadership but does not attribute the forecast or each policy to Xi personally.","limitations":["The 2023 growth figure is a projection published in December, not a final realized annual result.","The report identifies structural and external factors, so it does not isolate ruler-specific causation.","The extract does not describe the full executed budget or specific Xi decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2e51fa530cc99425","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The World Bank found that China's 2023 economic activity had picked up through services demand, resilient manufacturing investment, and public-infrastructure stimulus, but recovery remained fragile because of volatility, deflationary pressure, weak consumer confidence, and a property-sector downturn; it recommended debt-resolution reform, stronger conditions for private firms, social-safety-net strengthening, hukou liberalization, and inclusive finance.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns China's 2023 recovery and policy recommendations published December 14, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern China's policy environment under Xi's government, but the recommendations are from World Bank experts and are not evidence that Xi adopted them.","limitations":["The source reports some positive activity and stimulus but also identifies unresolved weaknesses; it does not provide a complete distributional analysis.","Recommendations are not evidence of enacted or implemented reforms.","The extract does not establish the causal contribution of Xi personally to the reported economic conditions."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus includes several metadata or navigation-only extracts; these were recorded as contextual facts with no question mapping where they contained no substantive ruler-period evidence.","Facts are limited to the supplied document text and do not independently verify official claims, second-hand accounts, projections, or bibliographic descriptions.","No scores are assigned."]}
